metadata.units: estimated persons per pixel; not persons/km2
metadata.clip_method: No resampling; pixel-centre mask. Border cells not area-weighted. Modelled total is not district census.
metadata.worldpop_attempt: Official 2025 922251437-byte raster download interrupted after ~25 MiB; HTTP Range returned 200, not 206. Partial .part file is not a valid raster and is excluded.
metadata.validation_warning: Government introduction reports about 500000/525000 people with mixed dates and scopes, while the cropped GHSL sum is about 892503. Review model/vintage/boundary mismatch before absolute demand scaling; do not call this the official district population.
metadata.gridAssignment: pixel centre; shared boundaries use smallest grid ID; edge tolerance 5m
metadata.notice: 2025模型人口，未经统计人口校准；仅作空间分布参考，不能当作真实充电需求。
